overall.summary: MOG-A shows a meaningful reduction in Risk Factors disclosure between the April and July 2025 10-Q filings, with the removal of detailed geopolitical/tariff commentary (including quantified FX impacts), program-specific revenue outlook language, and cost/margin pressure disclosures. While some content may have migrated to MD&A, the net effect is a thinner Risk Factors section at a time when tariff and macro risks remain elevated. The peer divergence flags were largely false positives, as MOG-A's accounting and supply chain disclosures are actually more detailed than its peers.
